work.status.label: state of this machine
work.status.tierSemanticTip: how knowledge search answers here: by words and by meaning. Opens AI features in Settings.
work.status.tierLexicalTip: how knowledge search answers here: by words only, so two repositories that reached the same conclusion in different words are not found. An embedding model adds meaning; AI features in Settings says how to name one.
work.status.driverTip: whether this machine is watching for work to start. Opens its settings.
work.status.sessionsTip: how many sessions the driver runs here: working, or waiting on you. Your own conversations are not counted. Opens Sessions.
work.status.workspaceTip: the workspace you are looking at. Everything on screen is scoped to it.
work.status.remoteTip: whether this workspace has a deployment to share with. Opens its wiring.
work.status.indexedTip: what the index holds for this scope. Opens the repositories it came from.
work.status.setupTip: how many of the steps this machine needs are done. Opens Get started.
work.status.zoomTip: the window's content is shown at {{percent}}%, and the bars around it keep their size. Goes back to 100%, as Ctrl+0 does.
